sn36.31:1.1: atthi bhikkhave sāmisā pīti atthi nirāmisā pīti. atthi bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti.
sn36.31:1.2: atthi sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ atthi nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ atthi nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ
sn36.31:1.3: atthi sāmisā upekkhā atthi nirāmisā upekkhā atthi nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā
sn36.31:1.4: atthi sāmiso vimokkho atthi nirāmiso vimokkho atthi nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho.
sn36.31:1.8: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā …pe…
sn36.31:1.9: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitavā rajaniyā.
sn36.31:1.11: yā kho bhikkhave ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati pīti ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisā pīti.
sn36.31:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn36.31:2.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:3.1: katamā ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti.
sn36.31:3.2: yā kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati pīti ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti.
sn36.31:4.4: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā …pe…
sn36.31:4.5: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn36.31:4.7: yaṃ kho bhikkhave ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ.
sn36.31:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn36.31:5.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:6.2: yaṃ kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ.
sn36.31:7.4: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā …pe…
sn36.31:7.5: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn36.31:7.7: yā kho bhikkhave ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati upekkhā ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisā upekkhā.
sn36.31:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn36.31:9.1: katamā ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā.
sn36.31:9.2: yā kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati upekkhā ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā.
sn36.31:12.1: katamo ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho.
sn36.31:12.2: yo kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati vimokkho ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkhoti.
